Title: Release catalogue
Body: Your released projects appear here. Start a project, write and record it, then mix and publish it. An empty release history is normal before your first release.

Title: Soccer career required
Body: These tournaments are available while you are an active professional soccer player. Return after joining a soccer club.

Title: Tournament requirements
Body: Check your qualification and current tournament. A club can enter once per age. World Cup appearances are four years apart. A tournament must finish at its starting age with the same club; you can close an expired tournament to begin a new season.

Title: Soccer competition record
Body: Qualification follows your native team’s latest recorded league position: 1–4 Champions League, 5 Europa League, 6 Conference League. Unranked teams must complete a native season first. These added cups keep their own match and trophy records.

Title: Tournament fixtures
Body: Three group matches award 3 points for a win and 1 for a draw. Four points qualify for the quarter-final, then semi-final and final. Tactical choices and your football training affect your chances; knockout matches include a decisive extra-time result.

Title: Play match
Body: Resolving the saved fixture.

Title: Match result
Body: Result key: 1 win, 2 draw, 3 loss. Knockout wins can include extra time.

Title: Cup final victory
Body: Record the title in your competition history.

Title: Tournament champions
Body: Your team won the cup. The title is saved in your soccer competition record.

Title: Tournament ended
Body: Your team was eliminated. Your appearance and results remain recorded; the next eligible tournament awaits.

Title: Close this tournament?
Body: This forfeits any unfinished fixtures. It does not restore a used club or World Cup entry.

Title: Parole and house arrest
Body: A successful parole-board release starts 3–5 years of house arrest. Vacation and emigration choices are restricted until the ending age. Home activities and annual parole check-ins are available here. The sentence expires automatically with age.

Title: House arrest unavailable
Body: You have no active house-arrest sentence, or this year’s activity is already complete. Successful parole assigns 3–5 years; completion is determined by your ending age.

Title: Parole officer check-in
Body: Report your home routine and complete your annual check-in.

Title: Check-in complete
Body: Your check-in is saved for this age. Continue your sentence until the ending age shown in your record.

Title: Study at home
Body: Use one of three home activity sessions this year.
